scope: single joint instantaneous weak transport and pressure experiment on original nodal unknowns, not an ocean-step factory
reconstruction: same piecewise-linear nodal hats with declared constant bed extension and exact consistent hat mass; original bed retained for qualification, last-node-truncated bed only an explicitly changed-domain localization control
physical_faces: shared fluid interval from maximum surface depth to minimum declared bed, periodic east and closed north wall; mean of reconstructed nodal velocity traces, original spherical face measures; never match equal node index as a substitute for physical overlap
weak_inventory: integrate each column's own test hat against the same centered physical tracer flux; integrate relative vertical transport times density times physical hat derivative, with relative transport derived from actual partial face volume integral and actual column surface rate; retain total-volume and global-inventory residuals, no residual compensation
pressure: differentiate exactly the same reconstructed potential at fixed consistent nodal content and surface; negative transpose of the new weak transport, using actual original velocity mass; do not assert arbitrary momentum or full mechanical energy qualification
quadrature: union of both wet-node knots and declared beds, also both actual surfaces; three-point Gauss on every piecewise-polynomial interval, exact through degree5; independent NumPy face-by-face five-point Gauss oracle and separate constant-mass continuity calculation
matrix: original/truncated beds, full wet/stairs, flat/variable surface, zero/constant/affine/random density; dimensional pressure-work and flat-surface zero/constant/physical-affine rest64eps unchanged; record every failed original-domain case even if changed-domain control passes
gates: constant tracer content rate equals actual hat-mass geometry rate at64eps of absolute contributing terms; global tracer sum zero at64eps of absolute rates; weak RHS agrees with independent NumPy at64eps of absolute quadrature contributions; exact work paired with independent RHS and physical rest measured separately; dry finite/NaN sentinels and first failures retained
no_promotion: centered consistent-mass transport is not a bounded accepted scheme; no limiter, source, physical diffusion, complete fast/slow, arbitrary moving momentum, ice, restart migration, actual1degree integration, time/space PDE order, century/climate/forecast or industrial rank established; no production imports or gate relaxation
execution: CPU controls and source-frozen audit first, actual CUDA on the identical finalized source next; report quadrature/local vertical workspace scaling rather than claiming global-linear working memory or full-mode throughput
